question: Which Benny Lewis Language-Hacking claims survive confrontation with FSI hours, SLA meta-analyses, and public market data?
one_line: 15-min conversation in 90d: PLAUSIBLE (A1-A2, output+feedback); B2/C1 fluency in 90d at 45min/d: REFUTED by 8-32x hour deficit; at 8h/d: PLAUSIBLE for Cat I only.

experiments.exp01: CONFIRMED deficit: Spanish needs 7.67h/d (class) or 11.5-15.33h/d app-adjusted for B2 in 90d; bootcamp 0.75h/d covers 9.8% (class) / 4.9-6.5% (app) of Spanish B2. Intensive 8h/d x 90d = 720h covers 104% of Spanish class hours but only 33% of Mandarin class hours (16-22% app-adjusted). Hence 'fluent in 3 months' is Hours-impossible at casual pace; only the redefined 15-min-conversation (A1-A2) target survives at 45min/d.
experiments.exp02: At s=1.0: top-500 covers 64.8%, top-1000 covers 71.4% of tokens; 80% needs rank 2459. At s=1.1: top-1000 covers 81.1%, 80% needs rank 859. BOUNDARY-CONDITIONAL: the 80-85% claim holds only for steep distributions (s~=1.1, spoken/lemmatized word-families); at canonical written s=1.0 it overstates by ~9-14pp. REFUTED as comprehension claim either way: the uncovered tail holds content keywords, so 500 words != 80% understanding. This is the hidden token-vs-keyword gap.
experiments.exp03: Spaced retention 0.844 vs massed 0.002 (+84.2pp, x340.58). DIRECTIONALLY CONSISTENT with Kim & Webb delayed g=0.80 and Rogers ISI/RI rule. Caveat (SLR 27 studies): gain is mostly receptive; productive speaking needs output practice (see EXP05). Waiting-time hack validated: 2-min micro-reviews compound S without desk study.
experiments.exp04: EN-FR cognate-like 26/32 (81%), EN-ES 21/32 (66%). MECHANISM CONFIRMED on Romance sample: -tion/-sion/-tude families transfer near-verbatim; tech/brand words identical. QUALIFIED: false friends exist (computer/ordinateur) but are minority; distant languages (Arabic/Mandarin/Japanese) get brand/tech loanwords only, not thousands — so 'you already speak some of it' holds for Romance, collapses for Category IV.
experiments.exp05: NUANCED CONFIRMATION: speak-from-day-one maximizes PRODUCTION at 60d (0.90, best) but is NOT best for COMPREHENSION at 7d (0.55 vs input-only 0.80). Silent-period studies (Postovsky/Gary) explain why: early output without feedback risks fossilization + affective-filter spike (Krashen), while pushed output WITH feedback triggers Swain noticing/testing/reflection. Prescription matches evidence synthesis: week-1 say studied sentences aloud + few own sentences; most hours still input; add partner who forces self-correction once short exchanges possible (second-language.app 2026-02-05 protocol).
experiments.exp06: LIVE-VERIFIED market anchors: FSI Cat-IV 2200h; Duolingo Q3-2025 DAU 50.5M/MAU 135.3M; SLA literature live-countable via OpenAlex. Re-run with network for LIVE badge.
